description: Read calls, timestamps, operations and resulting state. Optional finalization freezes the run. A linked repeat includes the previous frozen report while retained. No score, certification or judgment of the agent.

access_token.description: Secret short-lived run token. Omitted from reports. MCP client history may retain this argument.

finalize.description: True freezes the run and prevents further actions. Omitted means read only.

title: Read or finalize an agent test timeline
